title: Teenage Cricketer Breaks Records with Exceptional Skills
summary: Vibhav Suryanshi, a 16-year-old cricketer, broke two world records by becoming the first player to achieve these feats at such a young age. He achieved a Player of the Match award and series win in his 15th year of playing cricket. Vibhav's exceptional skills have earned him recognition globally. The Nepalese team, Kushal Mala, had previously held this record. Vibhav's achievements are a testament to his hard work and dedication.
title_hi: वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने दो विश्व रिकॉर्ड तोड़े हैं
summary_hi: वैभव सूर्यवंशी के नाम दो और विश्व रिकॉर्ड, 15 साल की उम्र में प्लेयर ऑफ द मैच और सीरीज जीत रचा इतिहास। वैभव की अपार महारत ने उन्हें विश्व स्तर पर पहचान दिलाई है। नेपाल की टीम, कुशल माला, इस रिकॉर्ड को पहले रखती थी।
summary_points_hi: वैभव सूर्यवंशी की उम्र 16 साल है।

framing.center: Centrist coverage reported on Vibhav's achievements without a distinct frame, focusing on the facts of his record-breaking feats.
